      "evidence": "Adds contrib/devtools/bitcoin-tidy/use-observers.cpp to automate and enforce accessor usage.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The added clang-tidy check is dedicated tooling to facilitate and enforce this specific CTransaction refactoring rather than a standalone developer tool."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/primitives/transaction.h and utility call sites.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Transaction structures are core domain primitives rather than shared general utilities or subtrees."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'Validation' and encapsulates the core consensus primitive CTransaction in src/primitives/transaction.h and src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Encapsulating CTransaction data members behind observer methods provides valuable architectural separation for future representation changes, but addresses no urgent bug or regression. As noted in the description, 'Once access goes through observers, the representation can change without requiring its users to change as well', which supports long-term interface segregation (#35904) though it 'is not a prerequisite' for it. Because it causes wide churn across consensus-critical code without immediate behavior or performance changes, it is reasonably deferrable cleanup."
    },

    }
